# ANCIENT CRAFTSMANSHIP MATERIAL SYSTEM
**Physical Surface Engineering & Craftsmanship Specification**

> *"No fantasy clichés. No plastic UI. Every surface is an ancient physical structure forged by centuries of human effort."*

---

## 1. THE SIX ANCIENT STRUCTURAL MATERIALS

```text
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 6 ANCIENT STRUCTURAL MATERIALS                                              │
├───────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ MATERIAL          │ PHYSICAL TEXTURE & CRAFTSMANSHIP CHARACTERISTICS        │
├───────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 1. Obsidian       │ Volcanic mirror glass — pitch black, sharp bevel edge   │
│ 2. Dragonstone    │ Soot-dark porous basalt — micro-fractures, weathered    │
│ 3. Valyrian Steel │ Rippled Damascus alloy — cool grey-blue luster, zero rust│
│ 4. Carved Marble  │ Veined ivory stone — smooth polished face, Latinate inc │
│ 5. Antiqued Brass │ Tarnished golden alloy — verdigris patina in crevices   │
│ 6. Forged Iron    │ Hammered charcoal iron — pitted surface, heavy rivets   │
└───────────────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. MATERIAL SPECIFICATIONS & CRAFTSMANSHIP DETAILS

### 1. Polished Obsidian (`.mat-obsidian`, `.mat-obsidian-surface`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Dense volcanic glass formed under cosmic heat. Hand-burnished with diamond grit to a mirror reflection that absorbs ambient light.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Sharp 1px chiseled bevel edge (`rgba(120, 140, 180, 0.07)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Deep 32px volumetric drop shadow (`0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.60)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Flawless, glass-smooth surface with micro-abrasions along outer corners.
* **UI Application**: Workspace base void, sidebars, file explorer panels.

---

### 2. Dragonstone (`.mat-dragonstone`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Soot-dark, coarse basaltic volcanic stone carved directly from subterranean fault lines.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Rough-hewn stone borders with 1px dark relief shadow (`rgba(80, 95, 120, 0.18)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Dense 36px ground-contact shadow (`0 10px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Pitted porous micro-granules, subtle soot staining along bottom edges.
* **UI Application**: Structural split dividers, modal backdrop covers, pane containers.

---

### 3. Valyrian Steel (`.mat-steel`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Folded rare alloy crafted with thousands of alternating steel-silver layers, exhibiting a distinctive rippled wave grain.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Precision-ground structural bevel edge (`1px solid rgba(199, 212, 227, 0.14)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Crisp 3px structural ridge shadow + top edge specular bevel highlight (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(199, 212, 227, 0.10)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Completely immune to rust or corrosion; maintains a cool grey-blue metallic luster across centuries.
* **UI Application**: Workspace tab rails, ledger table headers, section dividers.

---

### 4. Carved Marble (`.mat-marble`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Deep veined ivory-granite stone quarried from mountain peaks, smoothed with pumice and beeswax.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Carved relief border with subtle gold-leaf inlay (`1px solid rgba(220, 210, 190, 0.18)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Soft 24px ambient bounce shadow (`0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Faint grey-gold veins running diagonally across the stone face; polished smooth by thousands of scribe hands.
* **UI Application**: Active reading desks, primary note cards, metadata frontmatter.

---

### 5. Antiqued Brass (`.mat-brass`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Heavy copper-zinc alloy cast in clay molds and hand-engraved with ceremonial runic rings.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Antiqued brass border with verdigris patina accumulation in low relief (`1px solid rgba(217, 168, 87, 0.28)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Warm golden-brown glow shadow (`0 4px 20px rgba(100, 70, 20, 0.20)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Verdigris green tarnish in deep crevices, polished golden highlights on high-touch surfaces.
* **UI Application**: Badges, royal decree callouts, active check seals, command prompt rings.

---

### 6. Forged Iron (`.mat-iron`)
* **Physical Craftsmanship**: Heavy subterranean charcoal iron, hand-hammered on anvils and quench-hardened in oil.
* **Borders & Edge Details**: Heavy iron-strap borders with 1.5px dark steel rivets (`1px solid rgba(100, 115, 140, 0.22)`).
* **Depth & Shadows**: Heavy 40px subterranean occlusion shadow (`0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)`).
* **Aging & Weathering**: Hammer-pitted surface texture with dark iron-scale patina and oil-quenched sheen.
* **UI Application**: Holographic code block shells, prompt input containers, subterranean vaults.
